name.label: Store name
name.help: The name customers see. Your own data: it never goes to another installation.

locale.label: Language and number format
locale.help: A language tag such as bn-BD or en-GB. Dates and numbers are written in this language.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.help: Where the shop's day starts and ends, for example Asia/Dhaka.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Three-letter currency code, for example BDT.

stagingHost.label: Preview site address
stagingHost.help: Shown for information only. The server configuration decides the real address.

ownerData.settingReason: The owner's own data: kept out of every export to a new installation.

reasons.contact: Your shop's phone, WhatsApp, e-mail and address: never exported to a new installation.
reasons.legal: Your registered name, trade licence and DBID: never exported.
reasons.social: Your social page links: never exported.
reasons.payment: Your bank and mobile wallet details: never exported.
reasons.vault: Every key and password in the vault: never exported, not even encrypted.
reasons.areaList: Your own Dhaka area list (which area is in which delivery band): never exported.
reasons.connections: Your accounts with couriers, ad platforms, social pages and chat, and your domains: never exported.
reasons.people: Your staff, blog authors and photo models: never exported.
reasons.brand: Your shop's name, logo and brand voice: never exported.
reasons.records: Your customers and orders: never exported. An export carries settings and structure only.
reasons.media: Every file you uploaded (photos, logo, documents): never exported.

staffPasswordMinLength.label: Staff password: shortest length
staffPasswordMinLength.help: How many characters a staff password needs at least. Long is better than complicated.

customerPasswordMinLength.label: Customer password: shortest length
customerPasswordMinLength.help: How many characters a customer password needs at least. The first password is the customer's mobile number, so keep this at 11 or less.

passwordMaxLength.label: Password: longest length
passwordMaxLength.help: The longest password anyone may set. It only stops very long text from slowing the server.

blockCommonPasswords.label: Refuse common staff passwords
blockCommonPasswords.help: Staff cannot use a well-known password such as 12345678, or their own e-mail address.

staffSessionIdleMinutes.label: Staff: log out after this many idle minutes
staffSessionIdleMinutes.help: A staff login ends when nothing is done for this long.

staffSessionMaxHours.label: Staff: log out after this many hours in total
staffSessionMaxHours.help: A staff login ends after this long even when it is in use, and asks for the password again.

customerSessionDays.label: Customer: stay logged in for this many days
customerSessionDays.help: How long a customer stays logged in on one phone or computer.

loginMaxAttempts.label: Wrong passwords before a pause
loginMaxAttempts.help: After this many wrong tries in a row, the login waits before it accepts another try.

loginLockoutMinutes.label: Pause after too many wrong passwords (minutes)
loginLockoutMinutes.help: How long the login waits after too many wrong tries.

staffTwoFactorRequired.label: Staff must use 2-step login
staffTwoFactorRequired.help: When on, every staff member must set up an authenticator app code before using the admin. Off by default: you decide.

twoFactorChallengeMinutes.label: Time to type the 2-step code (minutes)
twoFactorChallengeMinutes.help: After the password is right, the code from the app must be typed within this time.

totpDriftSteps.label: 2-step code: allowed clock difference
totpDriftSteps.help: How many 30-second steps a phone clock may be early or late. 1 is normal.

staffLoginAlerts.label: Alert on every staff login
staffLoginAlerts.help: Records every staff login and every login from a new device, so you are told about it.

logo.label: Logo
logo.help: Your logo file from the media library. Your own data: it never goes to another installation.

slogan.label: Slogan
slogan.help: The line under the logo, in English and Bengali. Your own data.

phone.label: Hotline
phone.help: The number customers call, with the country code (+880…). Your own data.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.help: With the country code (+880…). Your own data.

email.label: Support e-mail
email.help: Where customers write to you. Your own data.

address.label: Shop address
address.help: Shown on Contact, the invoice and the policies. Empty = the line is hidden. Your own data.

registeredName.label: Registered business name
registeredName.help: As on the trade licence. Your own data.

dbid.label: DBID
dbid.help: Digital Business ID. Your own data.

accounts.label: Bank accounts
accounts.help: Shown to customers who pay by bank transfer. Your own data.

numbers.label: Mobile wallet numbers
numbers.help: bKash, Nagad and other numbers shown to customers. Your own data.

enabled.label: Cash on delivery
enabled.help: Your decision: empty until you switch it on or off. Changing it needs your written OK.

enabled.label: Size exchange
enabled.help: Customers may exchange for another size, and get a free replacement for a faulty, damaged or wrong item.

windowHours.label: Exchange window (hours)
windowHours.help: Counted from the courier's Delivered time. Every text on the site reads this number.

excludedCategories.label: Categories that cannot be exchanged
excludedCategories.help: Category web addresses, for example underwear.

summary.label: Exchange policy, short text
summary.help: {windowHours} is replaced by the exchange window.

afterDelivery.label: Returns after delivery
afterDelivery.help: Off = once delivered, items can be exchanged for size but not returned or refunded.

summary.label: Return policy, short text
summary.help: Shown on the product page, checkout and My account.

maxEdits.label: Edits per order
maxEdits.help: How many times a customer may edit an order before it goes into processing.

summary.label: Order editing, short text
summary.help: {maxEdits} is replaced by the number of edits.

freeOverMinor.label: Free delivery over
freeOverMinor.help: Order total from which delivery is free. Empty = no free delivery. Your decision: changing it needs your written OK.

enabled.label: AI helpers
enabled.help: Off until an AI provider is connected in Keys & connections. Until then every job runs on its plain fallback.

costSaver.label: Cost saver
costSaver.help: Uses the cheaper model wherever it does the job.

monthlyCapMinor.label: Monthly AI spending cap
monthlyCapMinor.help: Empty = not set, and AI stays off. Your decision: changing it needs your written OK.

preset.label: Theme
preset.help: Classic, Noir, Ivory or Festive. The whole site, the dashboard included, changes together.

largeText.label: Large text
largeText.help: Bigger text for customers who need it.

exchange.summary: Size exchange within {windowHours} hours of delivery. Free if the mistake is ours.

returns.summary: Once delivered, items can be exchanged for size, not returned or refunded.

orderEdit.summary: You can edit your order up to {maxEdits} times before we start processing it.
